import time as _time
MINUTE = timedelta(minutes=1)
HOUR = timedelta(hours=1)

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.theclass = time
    strptime = self.theclass.strptime
    assert strptime('+0002', '%z').utcoffset() == 2 * MINUTE, ('assertEqual', strptime('+0002', '%z').utcoffset(), 2 * MINUTE)
    assert strptime('-0002', '%z').utcoffset() == -2 * MINUTE, ('assertEqual', strptime('-0002', '%z').utcoffset(), -2 * MINUTE)
    assert strptime('-00:02:01.000003', '%z').utcoffset() == -timedelta(minutes=2, seconds=1, microseconds=3), ('assertEqual', strptime('-00:02:01.000003', '%z').utcoffset(), -timedelta(minutes=2, seconds=1, microseconds=3))
    for tzseconds, tzname in ((0, 'UTC'), (0, 'GMT'), (-_time.timezone, _time.tzname[0])):
        if tzseconds < 0:
            sign = '-'
            seconds = -tzseconds
        else:
            sign = '+'
            seconds = tzseconds
        hours, minutes = divmod(seconds // 60, 60)
        tstr = '{}{:02d}{:02d} {}'.format(sign, hours, minutes, tzname)
        t = strptime(tstr, '%z %Z')

    assert t.utcoffset() == 12 * HOUR + 34 * MINUTE, ('assertEqual', t.utcoffset(), 12 * HOUR + 34 * MINUTE)
    assert t.tzname() == 'UTC', ('assertEqual', t.tzname(), 'UTC')
